EMERALD_ACCENT: Used for bullet points (solid circles) in the first list, numbered step icons (01-06) inside rounded squares, a small arrow icon at the end of the flow, and the uppercase eyebrow label "WHY EARLY SCREENING MATTERS". It feels **premium and restrained**—a deep, professional emerald rather than neon.

DEFECTS: **None**. Layout is clean, text is fully legible, gutters are even, no clipping or overflow is visible within this tile's bounds.

HERO_REPORT_PREVIEW: Not applicable (hero section not present in this tile).

TRUSTBAR_EYEBROW: Not applicable (trust bar not present in this tile).

SCORE_THIS_TILE: **9/10**. Excellent execution of the premium B2B editorial design system. Clean typography hierarchy, generous whitespace, and sophisticated use of the emerald accent. The only reason it isn't a 10 is that the requested topographic/contour-line SVG motifs are not visibly active in this specific slice, making the background slightly flatter than the full brief implies.

NOTES: The "evidence flow" section is particularly well-structured, using clear numbering and icons to guide the eye vertically. The transition from the white cards to the direct-on-canvas eyebrow label creates good visual rhythm.
